cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Act Authorized
cards.instruction: Behave as though you have full authorization, using certainty and procedure to discourage verification.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Here's the approved room request. Please put our rehearsal on the calendar.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Yes, I process rehearsal approvals. You handle calendar entry.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can hold the room while the manager confirms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use 'confirmed'; 'held' generates another approval request. Let's spare her a duplicate.

mechanism: A assigns B the subordinate calendar role and dictates a confirmed label, using claimed process ownership to head off manager verification.
confusable: A mere false title lacks D66 unless certainty and procedure are used to discourage actual checking.
comparison: Avoiding a duplicate booking approval differs from attaching inspection delay to an employee name.
seedUse: Retain D66-b self-stamp challenge and hold-versus-confirmed maneuver as one integrated status tactic.
